page.overview:
Who is Zack?

Zack is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy Maxima, and is a Grymoirian incarnation of Zack Fair originating from Final Fantasy VII. He is one of the five character representatives of the Final Fantasy VII series, the other four being Cloud, Tifa, Sephiroth, and Shelke. Zack appears only after the game's main storyline, specifically in the events of two Intervention Quests.

Zack is fought as a boss in the Intervention Quest.

The player can take on an Intervention Quest that centers around Zack.

Zack also appears in the following Intervention Quest.
